article.headline: Scores from last Night: Lewisburg sweeps soccer; Horn Lake girls edge Center Hill
article.html:
Lewisburg swept Lake Cormorant in varsity soccer on Tuesday, November 3, winning the boys match 7–0 and the girls match 12–0. Both Patriots teams improved to 2–0 without allowing a goal in the doubleheader.

Basketball produced a split at Horn Lake: the Eagles’ girls held off Center Hill 41–37, while the Mustangs’ boys recovered from an early deficit to win 71–45.

Soccer: Lewisburg sweeps; DeSoto Central girls win

Lewisburg’s boys kept Lake Cormorant off the board in a 7–0 home win. The girls reached double figures in their 12–0 victory, completing a pair of shutouts and leaving both Lewisburg teams unbeaten in their reported season records.

DeSoto Central’s girls earned their first reported win, defeating Corinth 6–0. The Jaguars scored four times before halftime and twice afterward, moving their record to 1–3.

Florence boys and Brandon girls split wins

Florence’s boys scored the match’s only goal in the first half and protected that lead through a scoreless second half to beat Brandon 1–0. The Eagles improved to 3–0 in a matchup featured in our Tuesday Games To Watch preview.

Brandon’s girls took the other result, winning 5–0 at Florence. The Bulldogs scored twice in the first half and added three after the break, keeping the Eagles scoreless throughout.

Horn Lake girls hold off Center Hill; Mustangs boys pull clear

Horn Lake’s 41–37 girls victory gave the Eagles a 1–0 start. The narrow result contrasted with the boys game, where Center Hill built a much larger winning margin.

The Mustangs trailed Horn Lake 13–11 after the first quarter. Center Hill then outscored the Eagles 22–12 in the second quarter and 21–12 in the third on the way to a 71–45 road win.

Pine Grove wins both at Houlka

Pine Grove’s boys edged Houlka 69–65, while the girls won 46–15. Both Panthers teams finished with 1–0 records, taking the two varsity basketball results on the road.

Biggersville and Kossuth girls start with road wins

Biggersville’s girls beat Tremont 61–24 after taking control early. The Lions won the first quarter 19–9 and the second 24–6, creating separation before the break.

Kossuth’s girls also won away from home, defeating Hatley 62–31 in Amory. The Aggies improved to 1–0.

Simpson stays unbeaten; East Rankin beats Leake

Simpson Academy’s girls opened with a 25–8 first quarter against Cathedral and went on to win 64–47 in Mendenhall. The Cougars moved to 4–0.

East Rankin Academy’s boys defeated Leake Academy 44–37 in Pelahatchie. The Patriots began their reported season 1–0, while Leake’s record became 4–1.

Biloxi boys win on the Coast

Biloxi’s boys defeated visiting Pascagoula 71–47. The Indians opened with a 21–13 first quarter and finished with a 24–12 fourth quarter, recording a 1–0 start.
